- General Instructions:

- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for harming the integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, such as changing system settings, installing system-level software or stealing confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested if you need it for regularly repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request; it will not be approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 months from the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allow a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.

Please provide the full name of your GFT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

- Computer Name: GFT-Z9K3XbvTmWS (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
CNP
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
I need admin rights for downloading software I need for project work, like OBS, AWS CLI etc.
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the

baseline.answer:
Good morning,

If you need to install software only once, please do not request local administrator rights. Instead, submit a request through:

**Service:** Windows Software Installation  
**Subcategory:** I need software or a license installed on my computer

If you require administrator rights for recurring project-related activities, please provide the following information so the Local Admin Rights request can be completed:

- Whether the access is required short term or long term
- Full name of your manager/project manager at level L6 or above (L6+ employees may provide their own name)
- Computer name (Device Name in Company Portal or the result of `hostname` in Command Prompt)
- Computer system
- Client/project name
- Specific software or administrative actions required, with justification

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements. Approved rights must be renewed after 12 months.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GHT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

? Alter the base GHT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.

query_description: Il tuo PC risulta obsoleto e fuori garanzia. Ti cambieremo il vecchio PC Service TAG 4FRJN29 con uno nuovo. Ti abbiamo assegnato il nuovo PC con Service TAG YT8BJX6 Provvederemo a spedirti il nuovo PC nella filiale di Torino. Puoi darci conferma della filiale? A breve riceverai due mail: 1) Una relativa alla nuova assegnazione 2) Una relativa alla restituzione del tuo attuale device (da non considerare in caso hai esercitato il diritto di prelazione) Questo ticket verrà aggiornato quando il PC sarà disponibile per il ritiro in filiale. Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. Link utili: - Policy di assegnazione dei dispositivi aziendali https://shorturl.policy1 - Guide IT https://shorturl.guides1 L'IT provvederà alla cancellazione sicura dei tuoi dati ed al ripristino come condizioni di fabbrica del tuo vecchio pc. ------------------------------------------------- Your PC is obsolete and out of warranty. We will change your old device with Service TAG 4FRJN29 to a new one. We have assigned you the new device with Service TAG YT8BJX6 We will send you the new PC to the Turin office. Can you give us the confirmation of the branch? You will receive two emails: 1) Regarding the new PC assigned to you 2) Regarding the return of the old one (Please ignore if you already exercise the redeem old PC) This ticket will be updated when the device can be picked up in the office. We remind you that you can redeem your old PC. To exercise the pre-emption it's sufficient to confirm it in the ticket, after that we will contact you for resetting your old device remotely. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. NOTES: Remember that the pre-emption is valid if: You exercise the redemption of the old device within 7 days from the date of creation of this ticket. The old PC will be reset/returned to the IT office within 30 days from the date you picked up the new device. Useful links: - Device Policy https://shorturl.policy1 - IT Guides: https://shorturl.guides1 The IT will provide for the secure deletion of your data and the restoration of your old PC to factory conditions.

reference_reply:

- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GXK employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Laura Bianchi (Milano) (B72D)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GXK-LM8Kv7QrJSf (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GXK & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
PEF_J89012 - ID24-R9446 - Forborne (JE564119-614) Banco BPM
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
I need administrator permissions to download the RAD (Rational Application Developer) application and related programmes required to configure the working environment.
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GXK Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GXK Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GXK Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GXK Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GXK Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GXK Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GXK Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

feedback.answer:
Hello,

If RAD (Rational Application Developer) is a one-time software installation, please do not request administrator permissions. Submit a request through the portal using:

**Service:** Windows Software Installation  
**Subcategory:** I need software or a license installed on my computer

If you require administrator rights for recurring administrative tasks, please provide the following information instead:

1. Full name of your Project Manager or manager at level L6 or above (or an alternative approver)  
2. Computer name  
3. Whether the access is temporary or long term  
4. Clients and projects you support  
5. Justification for the required administrator permissions  
6. Confirmation that you have read and agreed to the Local Admin Rights Policy

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements.

- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GFT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or stealing confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeated tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demand us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.

Citrix

VPN configuration

- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.

✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ The software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
❌ Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
❌ Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (e.g., viruses and malware

Hello,

To renew your local administrator rights, please complete the Local Admin Rights request form and provide the following information:

- Whether the rights are required regularly (long-term) or for a temporary period
- Full name of your GFT employee manager/project manager at level L6 or above, or an alternative approver
- Computer name (Device Name in Company Portal, or run `hostname` in Command Prompt)
- Computer system (Windows/Mac)
- Client/project name
- Detailed justification, including the software or administrative actions required

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights are permitted under the applicable client requirements. The request must include a valid business justification and is subject to the GFT Local Admin Rights Policy. Approved rights must be renewed after 12 months.

Please provide the above information in this ticket so the request can be processed.

Best regards,  
Group IT

Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
?
